frequency_question: How often do major bipartisan infrastructure or energy reforms desired by key legislative leadership successfully pass within a single congressional session?
membership_rule: Members are major energy, permitting, or surface transportation omnibus bills that had leadership backing and faced cross-party negotiations, excluding pure partisan vehicles that failed by design.

cases.name: Bipartisan Permitting Reform Push of 2022 (Manchin proposal)

coverage_note: 6 major named instances of structured bipartisan infrastructure/permitting pushes in modern polarized Congresses.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller standalone bills that lacked leadership priority.
validity_reason: Structural congressional dynamics regarding infrastructure necessity remain stable across multiple electoral cycles.
